expectedText: Yes. There is a pharmacy across the street. I have a question about a word on a medicine label, but I will ask the professional there rather than guess. Which word is it? Dose. I will show the tablet package and ask what the label means. I will not decide what to take from the word alone. Did you write down your allergy question as well? Yes. My main question is what information they need. I will ask the nurse how to describe how I breathe and when I might recover. I will also ask for advice about my treatment. I can wait for you after my dentist visit. Thanks. Please meet me by the yellow bench at three thirty, not at the green entrance. I will text you if the time changes.
